learned: Implemented real fuse_tie_experience on the native usage-memory store (not the reference dual-store design), so fusion evidence and reads share one format and the path is genuinely commissioned rather than a stub. Design points derived from actual code: subject kinds are skill/agent/workflow (not project), the store records run_id/correlation_id with no effect_id, dispositions are a closed enum, and read_bounded_bytes must be imported locally. Three defects in my own implementation were caught by running it: a wrong effect_id lineage assumption, a missing local import, and an unknown-kind error being swallowed as corrupt_or_unavailable. Also replaced the earlier test that asserted the stub, since recording a stub as expected behaviour would have cemented it.
